research_question: Whether a common semantically aligned representation improves or clarifies cross-dataset robustness.
important_caution: No direct raw-feature cross-dataset comparison is claimed because the observed predictive schemas do not share an exact common feature set.
interpretation_rule: Common semantic alignment is judged by transfer performance, within-to-cross degradation, recall/FPR trade-offs, and capture-wise robustness; not by a single accuracy score.
